## Type of change

## Checklist

- [ ] The skill folder has a `SKILL.md` and a `README.md`.
- [ ] `SKILL.md` frontmatter includes `name`, `description`, `summary`, `version`, `author`, `license`, and `metadata.status`.
- [ ] I bumped the skill's `version` if its behavior changed (SemVer).
- [ ] I ran `python scripts/generate_catalog.py` and committed the README update.
- [ ] `python scripts/validate_skills.py` passes locally.
- [ ] I updated the skill's README **Changelog** (and `CHANGELOG.md` if notable).
